tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅// sdeb sbyor sna tshogs me tog gi chun po zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos bzhugs// ༄༅// sdeb sbyor sna tshogs me tog gi chun po zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// bde gshegs dbang po khyod kyi gsung zer tsha zer byed pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas rgya mtsho'i gos can 'di na log lta yi// tshang tshing brgyas gzings ston par khas 'che che bar mngon rlom sna tshogs 'byin byed sbrang rtsi'i dgra dang lus med rtsen// dpal mgrin mig stong lha yi bla ma gos med pas khrid gang gi gzhung lugs nyin mo long ba ltar mdzad pa// blo gter dbang pos blo yi kha 'byed rgyal ba nyid mor byed pa'i gsung 'od rab gsal rgyun du bdag gi spyi bor len// gang gis srid dang rnam grol rnam gsum gyi// the tshom drwa ba kun nas 'grol mdzad pa// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad skyed pa'i yum// 'jam mgon bla ma'i zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal// gangs ri'i khrod 'dir sngon chad mkhas rnams kyi// rna ba'i snod du nye bar ma lhung zhing*// lce yi dbang pos kun nas ma myangs pa// ro brgya'i 'byung gnas dpag bsam shing 'di bskyed// gzhung rtsom byed pa rnams kyang rmongs gyur na// de las gzhan pa smos kyang ci dgos pa// de 'dra'i don la kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal// bzang po blo gros 'jigs med de yis phye// rang gis brjod pa bde zhing*/ gzhan gyis rtogs par sla la/ gnyis ka'i rnar snyan pa zhig sdeb sbyor gyi gtsug lag shes na 'byung bas/ de mi mkhas pa rnams la bstan pa'i phyir 'di brtsam mo// tshigs su bcad dang rkyang pa dang*// rgyun chags zhes bya rnam pa gsum// tshig gi sbyor ba byed 'dod pa'i// mkhas pa rnams kyi 'jug ngogs yin// 'dir mkhas pa rnams bstan bcos rtsom pa la 'jug pa na/ brjod bya'i don ji snyed pa rnams tshigs su bcad pa dang*/

tshig lhug pa dang*/ rgyun chags pa zhes bya ba rnam pa gsum gyis ston la/ rgyun chags pa de'ang gnyis te/ rgyun chags bcad pa dang*/ ma bcad pa'o// de la rgyun chags bcad pa ni/ 'dir tshigs su bcad pa'i bye brag yin pas tshigs su bcad pa nyid kyi nang du bshad par bya'o// rgyun chags ma bcad pa ni/ sdeb sbyor gyi mtshan nyid lci yang la sogs pas phye la/ bya ba ston pa'i sgra yod pa/ rkang pa bzhir ma bcad pa ste/ de skad du yang sdeb sbyor gyi tshoms las/ rkang pa dag gis ma bcad pa// gang la yi ge sbrel legs yod// bya ba'i tshig gis gsal byas pa// de ni rgyun chags las gzhan min// zhes gdon pa'i phyir ro// 'di'i dper brjod pa ni kho bo'i bla ma chos kyi rje dpal sa skya pa rgyal mtshan gyi mthas brgyan pa'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i bstod pa 'ga' zhig las 'byung ba lta bu'o// 'di lta bu'i sdeb sbyor ni/ deng sang rgya gar na sdeb sbyor ba ches che ba mang du thos pa 'ga' zhig la grags pa tsam du zad kyi/ thams cad la grags pa ma yin la/ sbyor ba yang ches shin tu nyung bar snang ngo*// tshig lhug pa'i sbrel lugs ji ltar yin pa yang*/ kho bos mkhas pa rnams 'jug pa'i sgor bshad zin la/ 'dir skabs ma yin pa'i phyir rnam par dbye ba ma byas so// da ni skabs su bab pa tshigs su bcad pa'i sdeb sbyor la 'jug par 'dod pas/ 'dir ni tshig dbang sbyor rnams kyi// tshigs su bcad pa gsal bar bya// skabs 'dir ni tshig gi dbang po ste/ sdeb sbyor mkhan rnams kyis legs par sbyor ba/ tshogs par dbyung bar bya ba'i ngag gang gis sbyor shes na mkhas pa rnams kyi kha rgyan du 'gyur ba/ gya nom pa sbyor nus na rgyal po'i grwar rnyed pa dang bkur sti'i gter thob pa/ don dang tshig la sngon ma byung ba'i rgyan bsam pa dag pas sbyar na/ yi dam gyi lhas mngon sum du zhal ston pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug par mkhas pa rnams kyis snyan pa'i ba dan sgrogs par 'gyur ba'i gzhi sdeb sbyor gyi mtshan nyid bshad par bya'o// dmar ser dang ni rgyal ba'i lhas// mdo dang de yi dpe brjod byas// thog mar drang srong dmar ser zhes bya bas sdeb sbyor gyi mdo sbyar la/

de'i 'og tu rgyal ba'i lha zhes bya bas tshigs su bcad pa rnams kyi dper brjod pa sbyar ro// de dag gi rjes su gzhan dang gzhan rnams kyis kyang tha dad pa du ma 'bad nas sbyar mod kyi/ 'on kyang de dag gi dgod bya'i rim pa la mur thug pa med pa dang*/ lci yang gi ming la sogs pa tshigs su bcad pas ma bcings pa dang*/ phal cher mi gsal ba dang*/ gsal ba'i sbyor ba rnams kyang sngon med pa ma byas pa dang*/ ngal bso ba dang*/ lus dang ming rnams kyi 'dres pa yang ma phyed pa dang*/ de nyid kyis 'don pa na gdong pham par 'gyur ba dang*/ ngal gso ba dang*/ yi ge dag mi mnyam par gcod pas na/ go rim rigs pa med pa dang*/ tshigs su bcad pa 'ga' zhig 'don pa mi bde bas/ de dag sun phyung nas bde blag tu bstan pa'i phyir/ rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba yis// sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas mdzad// dus phyis rtsod pa'i dus kyi thams cad mkhyen par grags pa slob dpon rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas sdeb sbyor gyi bstan bcos rin chen 'byung gnas zhes bya ba yon tan brgyad kyis khyad par can du 'phags pa mdzad de/ de skad du yang*/ bsdus dang tshigs bcad rang bzhin gsal// mdo la dper brjod byas pa dang*// ma 'dres rim 'don tha ma ru// ngal gso'i yi ge yon tan yin// zhes bshad pas so// de lta bu'i tshigs su bcad pa de la dbye na/ 'phel dang bskyed pa'i dbye ba yis// tshigs su bcad pa rnam pa gnyis// 'phel ba yi ge bgrang ba ste// bskyed pa dag ni phyi mor bzhed// tshig ldan dang*/ rkang pa can dang*/ rkang pa bzhi pa dang*/ tshigs su bcad pa zhes bya ba ni rnam grangs so// tshigs su bcad pa de yang sdeb sbyor gyis dbye na gnyis te/ rgyud 'phel dang*/ bskyed pa'o// da yang yi ge bgrang ba ni/ rgyud 'phel zhes bya la/ phyi mo bgrang ba ni/ bskyed pa zhes bya'o// de dag gi gzhi dgod pa yang 'di ltar shes par bya ste/

dbyangs kyi yi ge nyi shu gnyis// gsal byed sum cu rtsa bdun yin// yi ge 'ba' zhig brjod pa gsal ba de ni dbyangs zhes bya'o// de'ang bsdu na gsum ste/ thung ngu dang*/ ring po dang*/ shin tu ring po'o// gcig gi tshad ni thung ngu yin la/ de ni rnam pa lnga ste/ a i u ṛ l̥'o// gnyis kyi tshad ni ring po yin la/ de ni rnam pa brgyad de/ ā ī ū ṝ e ai o au rnams so// gsum gyi tshad ni shin tu ring po yin la/ de ni rnam pa dgu ste ring po brgyad po'i mthar/ gsum gyi aṃ ga btags pa brgyad dang*/ dgu pa l̥'o// dper na ā gsum ī gsum ū gsum zhes bya ba nas l̥̄ zhes bya ba la sogs pa lta bu'o// de ltar na dbyangs nyi shu rtsa gnyis so// yi ge 'ba' zhig brjod pa mi gsal ba de ni/ gsal byed ces bya'o// de'ang bsdu na ka la sogs pa sde tshan lngas bsdus pa'i nyi shu rtsa lnga dang*/ ya la sogs pa mthar gnas bzhi dang*/ sha la sogs pa dro ba bzhi ste/ sum cu rtsa gsum dang*/ a klad kor can dang*/ a tsheg drag can dang*/ thaka lce rtsa can dang*/ ny+pa mchu can te bzhi bsnan pas sum cu rtsa bdun no// de ltar dbyangs dang gsal byed thams cad bsdoms na lnga bcu rtsa dgu yin no// tshigs su bcad pa'i yi ge bsngo ba na dbyangs bgrang gi gsal byed ni ma yin no// de skad du/ gsal byed rnams ni sum cu bdun// 'dir ni dbyangs yig nyi shu gnyis// de ltar yi ge lnga bcu dgu// dbyangs kyi yi ge bgrang bar bya// zhes 'byung bas so// 'di las gzhan du bshad pa ni// 'khrul pa yin par shes par byos// smra sgo las/ bsgrims dang klod la ring po med// ces 'don pa ltar na/ l̥ la ring po med par 'chad pa de ni paṇ+ḍi tas brjod pa'i don yi ge pas nor bar bris pa yin no// 'dir sgra'i bstan bcos ka lā pa dang tsan+d+ra pa dang pā ṇi ni la sogs pa dang*/ sdeb sbyor gyi bstan bcos rin chen 'byung gnas la sogs pa mtha' dag las l̥ la ring po med mod kyi/

ṛ la gsum ka tshang bar yod par bshad do// sdeb sbyor byed pas tshigs bcad la// lci dang yang dang ngal bso dang*// yi ge ming dang rgyan la sogs// rnam par bkod pas yid 'phrog byed// legs par sbyar ba'i rjes su 'brang ba'i tshigs su bcad pa sbyor ba rnams kyis/ dbyangs thung ngu la yang ba dang la zhes brda btags nas/ prastā ra 'dri ba na/ ri mo drang por 'dri'o// rkang pa mtha' ma'i dbyangs thung ngu phal cher lci bar yang 'gyur la/ gzhal mtshungs nas brtsams te sdeb sbyor 'ga' zhig de lta ma yin yang*/ mnyam pa'i rkang pa'i mtha' dang*/ dbang po rdo rje la sogs pa mi mnyam pa'i tshig gi mtha' rnams la de ltar yin no// dbyangs spangs pa'i gsal byed la/ thog ma'i thung ngu de yang lci ba'o// ring po dang shin tu ring po ni lci ba yin zhing*/ sdeb sbyor bas ga zhes 'ga' zhig tu brdar 'dogs la/ prastā ra 'dri ba na ri mo 'khyog por 'dri'o// de skad du sgra pa dag gis/ sbyar ba'i thog mar gang gyur dang*// tsheg drag can dang thig le can// tshig mtha' ring po'i yi ge yang*// 'di dag lci bar bstan pa yin// ces 'byung ba ltar ro// prastā ra dgod pa'i mdo yang*/ ma gsum lci ba na gsum yang*// bha thog lci ba ya thog yang*// dza dbus lci ba ra dbus yang*// sa mtha' lci ba ta mtha' yang*// ngal bso ba ni tshigs su cad pa 'don pa'i gnas kyi bye brag ste/ gnas dang*/ sdod dang*/ 'jog ces bya ba ni rnam grangs so// yi ge ni rjes su mtshungs pa dang*/ mi mtshungs pa la sogs pa'o// ming ni 'dod rgyal ba dang*/ rjes sgrub la sogs pa'o// rgyan ni tshig dang*/ don dang*/ dpe la sogs pa'o// gzhan yang bsres pa dang*/ yi ge dang*/ ming dang*/ tshig bsgyur ba la sogs pa yin no// 'di dag gi rnam gzhag rgyas par kho bos byas pa'i mkhas pa rnams 'jug pa'i sgor gsal la/ bye brag tu ngal bso ba'i gnas la sogs pa 'ga' zhig bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs rje la bskul bar bltas pas rnam pa tsam 'char bar 'gyur ro// dpe'i phyogs 'ga' tsam yang*/

legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter bu bshad pa lta bu'o// bha la sogs pa brgyad kyi tha mar u'i yi ge byung na ngal bso ba'i brda yin la/ lci ba la ngal bso na wa'i yi ge dang*/ yang ba la ngal bso na ka'i ming du 'gyur ro// 'jig rten pa la yang ngal bso ste/ gcod pa'i rnam gzhag yod do zhes bshad do// de ltar shes nas tshigs su bcad pa la 'jug pa na/ tshigs su bcad pa la rnam pa gnyis yod pa las/ thog mar 'phel ba zhes bya ba yi ge bgrang ba de bshad par bya'o// de'ang rnam pa gsum ste/ mnyam dang phyed mnyam mi mnyam pas// 'phel ba de yang rnam pa gsum// mnyam pa dang*/ phyed mnyam dang*/ mi mnyam pa zhes bya ba rnam pa gsum yod pa las/ thog mar mnyam pa'i 'phel ba bshad par bya'o// rkang pa dang po'i sdeb sbyor ltar// rkang bzhi mtshungs na mnyam pa yin// mnyam pa'i 'phel ba thams cad la// rkang pa dang po'i sdeb sbyor ji lta bar rkang pa lhag ma gsum ka yang de dang mtshungs na mnyam pa yin no// de dag so sor bshad na/ yi ge gcig nas lnga yi bar// tshigs su bcad par grags mod kyi// mkhas pa phal cher de bsgrub pa'i// mtshan nyid dbye ba btang snyoms mdzad// sngon gyi rabs las grags pa yi ge gcig gi tshigs bcad la brjod pa/ gnyis pa la shin tu brjod pa/ gsum pa la lhan cig bar ma/ bzhi pa la rab gnas/ lnga pa la legs par rab gnas/ zhes 'dod do// de skad du/ brjod dang shin tu brjod par ma// rab gnas legs par rab gnas dang*// dbyangs sgrogs rab dga' go rim bzhin// dmar ser gyis ni bshad pa yin// ces sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas las 'byung ngo*// de dag gi bye brag gi dbye ba la/ yi ge gcig pa'i tshigs su bcad pa'i bye brag ni dpal zhes bya'o// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ dbyangs can dang*/ brtan pa'o// gsum pa ni lcags sgrog go /bzhi pa la gnyis te/ nor rgyun dang*/ 'byor ldan no// lnga pa la gnyis te/

ral gri'i bu dang*/ pi wang ngo*// tshig rkang lnga pa yan chad pa'i ming 'di rnams slob dpon rtag pa'i sdes/ rje btsun sgrol ma la bstod pa bṛt+ta mā la zhes bya ba'i rjes su 'brangs nas bshad la/ 'di rnams kyi tha snyad 'ga' zhig mi 'dra ba slob dpon dzñā na shrī mi tras 'phags pa 'jam dpal la bstod pa/ bṛt+ta mā la zhes bya ba nas kyang 'byung mod kyi/ yi ge mangs pas 'jigs pas ma bris so// de dag phyogs tsam dper bya ba// kho bo'i rje btsun dpal ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs la bstod par sbyar na/ yi ge gcig pa'i tshigs bcad/ blo/ mchog dpal/ dbyangs/ yi ge gnyis pa la/ dbyangs can/ khyod bsgrubs/ spobs pa/ brtan thob/ yi ge gsum pa la/ khyod kyi gsung*/ gnyis med blo/ lcags sgrog gis/ sbrel legs 'dra/ yi ge bzhi pa la/ rgyal sras dbang po/ 'jam dbyangs khyod kyis/ legs bshad nor rgyun/ bdag blo tshim mdzad/ yi ge lnga pa la/ brtse ldan khyod kyi gsung*/ dri za'i pi wang ltar/ snyan cing 'jebs pa yis/ gdul bya'i yid 'phrog byed/ ces pa lta bu ste/ sngon chad ma thos pa rnams la sdeb sbyor gyi dga' ston dgye ba'i phyir bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// slob dpon rin chen 'byung gnas ni yi ge drug pa man chad la/ tshigs su bcad pa mtshan nyid par bzhed de/ tshigs bcad rnams la mkhas phyir drug pa nas brtsams te re re spel ba'i rkang pa bya/ zhes 'byung ba'i phyir ro// des na 'dir de'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ yi ge drug pa nas brtsams te// yi ge re re spel ba la// ngal bso ba dang lci yang gi /rab tu dbye bas tshigs bcad 'grub// tshigs su bcad pa 'di rnams la yang*/ spyi'i ming dang*/ bye brag gi dbye ba gnyis gnyis yod pa las/ thog mar spyi yi ming brjod pa// dbyangs sgrogs rab dga' rjes su bsngags// bṛ ha ti dang phreng ldan dang*// gsum pa sngags yan chad rkyang pa yin/

yi ge drug pa dbyangs sgrogs/ bdun pa rab dga'/ brgyad pa rjes su bsngags pa/ dgu pa bṛ ha ti/ bcu pa phreng ldan/ bcu gcig pa gsum bsngags te/ de dag rkyang pa yin no// skye 'gro man chad shin tu la// sogs pas 'phangs pa'i rkang pa can// nyi shu drug gi bar du bzhed// yi ge bcu gnyis pa skye 'gro/ bcu gsum pa shin tu skye 'gro/ bcu bzhi pa nus ldan/ bco lnga pa shin tu nus ldan/ bcu drug pa legs spyod/ bcu bdun pa shin tu legs spyod/ bco brgyad pa brtan 'dzin/ bcu dgu pa shin tu brtan 'dzin/ nyi shu pa byed ldan/ nyi shu rtsa gcig pa shin tu byed ldan/ nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa kun byed// nyi shu rtsa gsum pa rnam byed/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa legs byed/ nyi shu rtsa lnga pa shin tu legs byed/ nyi shu rtsa drug pa lhag par legs byed ces bya'o// rkang pa can zhes bya ba ni tshigs su bcad pa zhes bya ba'i don to// yi ge nyi shu rtsa bdun pa nas rgyun chags pa'i bye brag tu 'gyur ro// 'di'i cha rig byed kyi gzhung lugs las kyang 'di skad 'don te/ rig byed la rwa bzhi/ 'di'i rkang pa gsum/ mgo gnyis/ lag pa bdun/ de 'dir gsum nas bcings na// khyu mchog 'di ni nga ro 'don// zhes bya ste/ rwa bzhi ni rig byed bzhi/ mgo gnyis ni/ oṃ dang dbyangs kyi sdeb sbyor/ lag pa bdun ni sdeb sbyor bdun te/ drug pa dbyangs sgrogs ni dus drug bdun pa rab dga' ni drang srong bdun/ brgyad pa rjes su bsngags pa ni nor lha brgyad/ dgu pa bṛ ha ti ni gza' dgu/ bcu pa phreng ldan ni phyogs skyong bcu/ bcu gcig pa gsum bsngags ni drag po bcu gcig bcu gnyis pa skye 'gro ni nyi ma bcu gnyis/ snying ga dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ mgo bo gsum/ ngag khyu mchog gi yi ge oṃ/ rkang pa gsum ni sbyin sreg grong pa lho phyogs kyi me gsum/ yang me lce bdun pa zhes kyang bshad de/

de ltar na sdeb sbyor 'di dag rang byung skyes bus ma byas par 'dod do// //de ltar spyi'i ming brjod nas/ bye brag gi mtshan nyid brjod na/ yi ge drug pa dbyangs sgrogs la bye brag la/ ta ya gsum sdod dbus phra yin// ta dang ya gnyis la yi ge gsum gsum la ngal bso ba yod na dbus phra zhes bya bar 'gyur ro// de dang mtshan nyid mi 'dra ba 'ga' zhig la chu srin mgo zhes kyang bstan bcos gzhan nas bshad do// bdun pa rab dga'i bye brag la// gzhon nu rol pa dza sa lci// dza dang sa'i mthar lci ba gcig yod na gzhon nu rol pa zhes bya'o// brgyad pa rjes su bsngags pa'i bye brag la/ lci yang bzhir bsgres 'dra mtshungs te// lci ba'i yi ge dang yang ba'i yi ge sbyar ba lan bzhir bsgres pas yi ge brgyad du byung ba ni/ 'dra mtshungs so// yang lci bzhi pa gzhal dpag yin// snga ma las bzlog pa yi ge brgyad pa gzhal dpag go /bha gnyis lci ba gnyis rkang bkra// bha gnyis kyi mthar lci ba'i yi ge gnyis sbrel ba ni rkang pa bkra ba zhes bya'o// ma gnyis lci ba zung glog phreng*// ma gnyis kyi mthar snga ma bzhin lci ba gnyis sbyar ba ni glog gi phreng ba'o// bha ta yang lci bram ze'i bu// bha dang ta'i mthar yang ba dang lci ba'i yi ge yod na bram ze'i phru gu zhes bya bar 'gyur ro// 'di la dmar ser gyis bram ze'i phru gu rtsen pa zhes btags so// bstan bcos gzhan las yi ge mnyam la mtshan nyid mi 'dra ba 'ga' la yon tan zhes bya ba dang*/ pad+ma can dang*/ phan byed dang*/ lo 'dab ces bya ba'i sdeb sbyor yang yod do// dgu pa bṛ ha ti bye brag la/ ra na sa ni gshol gdong yin// ra dang na dang sa rnams legs par sbrel ba ni gshol gdong ngo*// na na ma ni ltos 'gro'i bu// na gnyis dang ma sbrel ba ni/ ltos 'gro phru gu 'gro zhes grags so// gzhan las zur gyis lta zhes bya ba dang*/

phyag rgya zhes bya ba mtshan nyid tha dad pa yang bshad do// bcu pa phreng ldan la/ ma sa dza ga dag par snang*// ma dang sa dang dza'i mthar lci ba gcig yod na dag pa'i snang ba zhes 'dod do// ma na ya lci ba ṇa ba// ma dang na dang ya'i mthar lci ba'i yi ge gcig yod na/ rnga pa ṇa ba zhes bya bar 'gyur te/ de'i sgra dang mtshungs par grags pa'i phyir ro// ra dza ra ga rma bya'i 'gros// ra dang dza dang ra'i mthar lci ba gcig yod na rma bya'i 'gros zhes bya'o// bha ma sa ga gser ldan 'gyur// bha dang ma dang sa'i mthar lci ba gcig yod na gser ldan no// ma bha sa ga myos ma yin// ma dang bha dang sa'i mthar lci ba gcig yod na myos ma'o// gzhan las na li ni// bzang ldan gtso/ tsam pa'i phreng ba/ sprin gyi bla re/ bde blag byed ces 'don pa yang yod do// bcu gcig pa gsum bsngags la/ ta dza dza ga ga nyer 'khod// ta dang dza gnyis dang lci ba gnyis yod na nyer 'khod ces bya'o// ta gnyis dza mthar lci ba gnyis// dbang po rdo rje'i tshigs bcad yin// ta dang ta dang dza'i mthar lci ba'i yi ge gnyis yod na dbang po rdo rjes zhes grags so// dza ta dza mthar lci ba gnyis// sdeb sbyor nye dbang rdo rjer 'dod// dza dang ta dang dza'i mthar lci ba gnyis yod na/ nye dbang rdo rje zhes bya'o// rdo rje rnam gnyis bsres pa la// nyer bskyed zhes byar dran dbang 'dod// dbang po rdo rje dang nye dbang rdo rje gnyis bsres pa la nyer bskyed ces dran pa'i dbang po rnams 'dod de/ 'di las rab tu dbye ba mang du'ang 'byung ngo*// bha gsum ga gnyis bsdebs pa la// 'jo ba po zhes tshig mkhan 'dod// bha gsum gyi mtha' mar lci ba gnyis sbyar ba la 'jo ba po zhes snyan ngag mkhan rnams 'dod do// ma lci ra gnyis ci rig byed// ri la 'jog pa sā li ni// ma'i mthar lci ba gcig dang*// ra gnyis kyi mthar lci ba gcig sbyar ba la bzhi dang bdun pa la ngal bso na sā li ni zhes bya'o// ma lci sa ra lci sngon bzhin// ngas bso rlung gi dba' rlabs phreng*// ma'i mthar lci ba gcig dang*/

sa dang ra'i mthar lci ba gcig sbyar ba la sā li ni ltar bzhi dang bdun la ngal bso na rlung gi dba' rlabs phreng zhes bya'o// rgyal ba'i lha ni rlung gi dba' rlabs zhes 'dod do// ma lci na gnyis lci sngon bzhin// 'jog pa bung ba rol pa yin// ma'i mthar lci ba gcig dang na gnyis kyi mthar lci ba gcig yod la/ sngar bzhin bzhi dang*/ bdun la ngal bso na bung ba rol pa zhes bya ba'i sdeb sbyor du 'gyur ro// ra na ra mthar yang ngang lci// sngar bzhin ngal bso shing rta dregs// ra dang na dang ra'i mthar yang ba gcig dang lci ba gcig sbyar ba'i bzhi pa dang bdun pa la ngal bso ba ni shing rta dregs zhes bya bar 'gyur ro// ra na bha mthar lci dang lci// legs par sbyar ba legs 'ongs yin// ra dang na dang bha'i mthar lci ba gnyis sbyar ba'i tshigs su bcad pa ni legs 'ongs zhes bya'o// na gnyis sa mthar lci ba zung*// sdeb legs de ni zlum por bzhed// na gnyis dang sa'i mthar lci ba gnyis sbyar nas legs par bsdebs nas zlum po zhes bya'o// na na ra mthar yang dang lci// sbyar ba'i sdeb gnas zhes bya bar 'gyur ro// bstan bcos gzhan las ni/ de dag dang yi ge mnyam la mtshan nyid mi 'dra ba 'ga' zhig la kun tu bzang ldan dang*/ gnas su phyin pa dang*/ khas bzangs ldan zhes 'don pa yang yod do// //yi ge bcug nyis pa skye 'gro la// ra na bha sa zla ba'i lam// ra dang na dang bha dang sa yod na zla ba'i lam zhes bya'o// dza ta dza ra rgyud gnas yin// dza dang ta dang dza dang ra rnams thog ma yi ge brgyad dang*/ de nas yi ge bzhi pa la ngal bso na kha sbyor zhes bya'o// dza su lan gnyis drug pa la// ngal bso ba ni chu 'thor 'gro// dza dang sa dang dza dang sa la yi ge drug pa'i gnas su ngal bso na chu 'thor 'gro'o// sa bzhi sbrel ba to ṭa ka /sa'i yi ge lan bzhir sbrel ba ni to ṭa ka'o// na bha bha ra dal myur yin// na dang bha gnyis dang ra'i yi ge sbyar ba ni dal myur zhes bya'o// ya bzhi ltos 'phye rab tu ltung*// ya bzhi sbrel ba ni ltos 'phye rab tu ltung ba zhes bya'o// me tog phreng rgyud ra bzhi pa// ra bzhi sbrel ba'i sdeb sbyor ni// me tog phreng rgyud ces bya'o// sa dza sa gnyis yi ge nyung*// sa dang dza dang sa gnyis yod pa'i sdeb sbyor ni yi ge nyung ngu zhes bya'o// ma lci lci ba ra gnyis lci// mda' ri ngal bso sna tshogs lha// ma'i yi ge'i mthar lci ba gnyis dang ra gnyis kyi mthar lci ba gcig yod cing*/ yi ge lnga pa dang de nas bdun pa la ngas bso na sna tshogs lha mo zhes bya'o// ma lci na ya lci ba gnyis// bzhi brgyad 'jog pa chu 'dzin phreng*// ma'i mthar lci ba gcig dang na dang ya'i mthar lci ba gnyis yod na yi ge bzhi pa dang brgyad pa la ngal bso na chu 'dzin phreng ba zhes bya'o// na gnyis ra ra dal gyis 'bab// na gnyis dang ra gnyis sbrel ba ni lha'i chu dal gyis 'bab pa dang mtshungs pa'i phyir de skad ces bya'o// na dza dza ra ya mu na// na'i mthar dza gnyis dang ra gcig yod pa ni/ chu klung ya mu na dang mtshungs pa'i phyir sdeb sbyor gyi ming de skad ces bya'o// na dza bha ya phreng ba gsar// na dang dza dang bha dang ya bsgrigs te bsdebs pa ni phreng ba gsar ldan zhes bya'o// sdeb sbyor gyi bstan bcos gzhan las ni/ ngag gi dbang phyug rtsen pa/ kun+da'i 'khri shing*/ sna tshogs can/ 'dod ster/ rol pa can/ zur sbyor/ ri dwags mchongs/

zhes bya ba'i sdeb sbyor du 'dod pa yang mthong ngo*// //yi ge bcu gsum pa shin tu skye 'gro la phye na/ mu na dza ra lci yon tan// phyogs su sdod pa rab spro ma// ma dang na dang dza dang ra'i mthar gnyis lci ba gcig /yid 'ong ngang pa'i sdeb sbyor yin// sa dang dza dang yang sa gnyis kyi mthar lci ba gcig yo na/ ngang pa'i rgyal po gshog pa khra bo'i ro dang mtshungs pa'i phyir yid du 'ong ba zhes bya ste/ 'dab bkra ngang pa zhes kyang byar rung ngo*// sa dza gnyis ldabs mthar lci ba// tshigs su bcad pa 'jam pa'i ngag /sa dang dza dang yang sa dang dza'i mthar lci ba gcig yod na/ sdeb sbyor de ni 'jam pa'i ngag ces mkhas pa rnams la grags so// bstan bcos gzhan las 'od ldan zhes bya ba dang*/ mngag gzhug ces 'don pa yod do// //yi ge bcu bzhi pa nus ldan la phye na/ ma mthar lci gnyis na gnyis ma// rkang ldan de ni gnod med yin// ma'i yi ge'i mthar lci ba gnyis dang na gnyis kyi mthar ma'i yi ge gcig yod na rkang ldan de la ming gnod med ces grags so// rkang ldan ni tshigs su bcad pa zhes bya ba'i don to// na gnyis lci mthar dza gnyis lci// bdun 'jog gzhan gyis mi thub pa// na gnyis kyi mthar lci ba gcig yod cing dza gnyis kyi mthar lci ba gcig yod la yi ge bdun pa'i gnas su ngal bso na gzhan gyis mi thub pa zhes bya ba'i rkang ldan du 'gyur ro// na gnyis lci ba lan gnyis bsgyur// mtshon cha kha 'bus bdun par 'dod// na gnyis kyi mthar lci ba gcig yod la slar yang na gnyis kyi mthar lci ba gcig yod na/

snga ma ltar yi ge bdun pa'i gnas su ngal bso na mtshon cha kha 'bus zhes bya'o// ta bha dza gnyis lci ba gnyis// dpyid kyi thig le rkang bzhi pa// ta dang bha'i mthar dza gnyis dang lci ba gnyis sbrel ba ni dpyid kyi thig le zhes bya'o// rkang pa bzhi pa ni tshigs su bcad pa zhes bya ba'i rnam grangs so// sa mthar yang lci na ra gnyis// mda' dang gzar sdod nor 'dzin yin// sa'i mthar yang ba'i yi ge gcig dang lci ba'i gcig dang na dang de nas ra'i yi ge gnyis sbrel nas/ yi ge lnga pa dang dgu pa'i gnas su ngal bso ba'i rkang bzhi pa ni nor 'dzin ces bya'o// bstan bcos gzhan las kun+da can// sha ra bha/ lha nyid ces bya ba mtshan nyid gzhan pa yang snang ngo*// //yi ge bco lnga pa shin tu nus ldan la phye na/ yang ba bcu bzhi sbrel ba'i mthar// gcig lci ri bong can gyi cha// yang ba'i yi ge bcu bzhi'i mthar lci ba gcig sbyar nas bar du ngal bso ba'i gnas med pa ni/ ri bong can gyi cha zhes grags so// de nyid ro dang gza' gnas su// ngal bso ba ni me tog phreng*// ri bong can gyi cha'i sdeb sbyor nyid la yi ge drug pa dang dgu pa'i gnas su ngal bso na me tog phreng ba zhes bya bar 'gyur ro// de nyid nor lha thub pa ru// gnas pa yon tan nor bu'i tshogs// snga ma'i sdeb sbyor de nyid la// yi ge brgyad pa dang bdun par ngal bso na yon tan nor bu'i tshogs zhes bya bar sdeb sbyor mkhan rnams la grags so// na gnyis lci gnyis ra gnyis lci// nor dang rir 'jog phreng ldan ma// na gnyis dang lci ba gnyis dang ra gnyis kyi mthar lci ba gcig yod pa'i rkang pa can la/ yi ge brgyad pa dang bdun par ngal bso ba ni phreng ldan ma zhes bya'o// na dza bha dza ra sbrel legs// rgya mtsho zhes bya'i tshig ldan yin// na dang dza dang bha dang dza dang ra rnams tshig mkhan gyis bsdebs legs par gyur na rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i sdeb sbyor ro// tshigs ldan zhes bya ba'ang tshigs su bcad pa zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go

/sdeb sbyor gzhan las lus med// rnam bsgyings/ 'dod ldan ma/ bde 'gro dga'/ nor bu yon tan tshogs zhes 'don pa yang yod do// //yi ge bcu drug pa legs spyod ces bya ba la phye na/ bha ra yang dang na gnyis sa// glang chen mchog rtsen ri bug sdod// bha dang ra dang de'i mthar yang ba gcig dang de nas na gnyis kyi mthar sa gcig yod cing yi ge bdun pa dang dgu pa la ngal bso na/ khyu mchog glang chen rtsen pa zhes grags so// glang chen mchog rtsen ces sbyar ba ni/ tshigs su bcad pa bsdebs pa'i ngor bas so// na dza bha dza ra lci ba// le brgan rtsi zhes rgyud mkhan 'dod// na dang dza dang bha dang dza dang ra'i mthar lci ba gcig yod na me tog le brgan rtsi zhes 'dod de/ rgyud mkhan ni tshig gi phreng ba rgyud mkhas pa'i phyir sdeb sbyor mkhan no// gzhan las ni de dang mtshan nyid mi 'dra ba 'ga' zhig la/ mi g.yo brtan/ ku pa la lo ma bkod pa/ gzhon nu'i rtse 'jo/ dge byed/ rab mchog rol pa zhes grags pa yang yod do// //yi ge bcu bdun pa shin tu legs spyod la phye na/ ya mu na sa bha yang lci// rtse ldan ma ste ro drag sdod// ya dang mu dang na dang sa dang bha'i mthar yang ba gcig dang lci ba gcig yod la/ yi ge drug pa dang bcu gcig pa la sdod cing ngal bso na rtse mo can ma zhes bya'o// mu'i u ni ngal bso ba'i gnas nges par bya ba'i brda sbyar ba'o// dza sa yang lci na ra gnyis// yangs ldan nor lha bu gar sdod// dza dang sa'i mthar yang ba dang lci ba'i yi ge yod la/ de nas na gcig dang ra'i yi ge gnyis yod cing*/ yi ge brgyad pa dang dgu par ngal bso na yangs ldan zhes bya'o// yangs ldan ni sa'i ming gi rnam grangs te/ 'dir sa gzhi zhes bya bar yang rung ngo*// de nyid lag pa yon tan dang*// tshig mthar sdod na bdud rtsi yin// sdeb sbyor snga ma nyid la yi ge gnyis pa dang*/ de nas gsum pa dang*/

de nas tshig rdzogs pa'i gnas su ngal bso na bdud rtsi zhes grags so// bha ra na lci na na lci// smyug 'dab ltung ba phyogs thub sdod// bha dang ra dang na'i mthar lci ba gcig dang yang na gnyis kyi mthar lci ba gcig yod cing yi ge bcu pa dang bdun pa'i gnas su ngal bso na smyug 'dab ltung zhes bya'o// na su ma lci dza gnyis lci// ro chu dbyangs sdod ri dwags mo// na dang sa dang ma dang lci ba gcig dang*/ de nas dza gnyis kyi mthar lci ba gcig yod cing yi ge drug pa dang*/ de nas bzhi pa dang*/ de nas bdun pa la ngal bso na ri dwags mo zhes 'dod do// su'i u ni ngal bso ba'i brda'o// ma lci na su ra gnyis lci// chu dus rir 'jog dal gyis gnon// ma'i mthar lci ba dang na dang sa dang ra gnyis dang lci ba yod cing*/ yi ge bzhi pa dang*/ de nas drug pa dang*/ de nas bdun pa la ngal bso na dal gyis gnon zhes bya'o// na dza lci na bhu bha lci// ri ro chur sdod khu byug yin// na dang dza'i mthar lci ba dang na dang bha gnyis kyi mthar lci ba gcig yod cing*/ yi ge bdun pa dang drug pa dang bzhi par ngal bso na khu byug ces bya'o// gzhan la sa na rku ṭa dang*/ nor rgyun dang*/ rab dbyangs zhes sbyor ba'ang yod do// //yi ge bco brgyad pa brtan 'dzin la phye na/ ma dang lci gnyis na su ra// ra lci 'khri shing gnas gsum sdod// ma'i mthar lci ba gnyis dang na dang sa'i mthar ra gnyis dang lci ba gcig yod cing*/ yi ge lnga pa dang*/ drug pa dang*/ bdun par ngal bso ba ni/ me tog g.yo ba'i 'khri shing zhes bya'o// na gnyis ra bzhi sbrel ba la// lcags mda' zhes bya'i tshig ldan 'byung*// ngal mi bso bar na gnyis dang ra yig bzhi sbrel ba la lcags mda' zhes bya'o// tshig ldan ni tshigs su bcad pa'o// sdeb sbyor gzhan las ta ma la'i 'dab ma/ me tog rna rgyan/ tsa ra tsa ri/ myos pa'i rtse 'jo zhes grags pa yang yod do//

//yi ge bcu dgu pa shin tu brtan 'dzin la phye na/ ya mu na su ra gnyis lci// dus drug ltar sdod sprin rnam sgrogs// ya dang ma dang na dang sa'i mthar ra gnyis dang lci ba gcig yod cing*/ yi ge drug pa dang*/ yang drug pa dang*/ de nas bdun par ngal bso na// sprin rnam sgrogs zhes bya'o// mu dang su'i u ni ngal bso ba'i gnas nges par byas pa'o// ma sa dza su ta gnyis lci// nyi ma rta la sdod pa stag /rnam par rtsen pa zhes tshig gi lhag mar sbyar ro// ma dang sa dang dza dang sa dang ta gnyis kyi mthar lci ba yod cing yi ge bcu gnyis pa dang bdun par ngal bso na gcan gzan gtso bo'i rnam par rtsen pa zhes bya'o// gcan gzan gtso bo'i sgra seng ge dang stag gnyis la 'jog pa las/ 'dir shartu la'i sgra stag la sbyar ro// su'i u ni ngal bso ba'o// //yi ge nyi shu pa byed ldan la phye na/ kha mdzes ma ra lci na gnyis// lci dang ta su gnas gsum sdod// ma dang ra dang de nas lci ba'i mthar na gnyis dang*/ lci ba gcig gi mthar ta dang sa yod cing yi ge bdun pa dang yang bdun pa dang drug pa la ngal bso na kha mdzes zhes bya'o// ra dza gsum bsgres lci dang yang*// zlum po zhes ni mkhas rnams 'dod// ra dang dza la na gsum du bsgres pa'i mthar lci ba'i yi ge gcig dang yang ba gcig byung na zlum po zhes bya bar 'gyur te/ zlum po'i ngang tshul de la yod pa'i phyir ro// zhes gsungs so// gzhan las ni rol ldan ma dang*/ seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa zhes sbyar ba yang yod do// //nyi shu rtsa gcig pa ra btu byed ldan la phye na/ ma ra na gnyis ra gnyis lci// bdun par lci sdod phreng rgyud 'dzin// ma dang ra'i mthar lci ba gcig dang yang na gnyis kyi mthar lci ba gcig dang yang ra gnyis kyi mthar lci ba gcig yod cing*/ yi ge bdun pa gsum gyi gnas su ngal bso na me tog phreng rgyud 'dzin ces bya'o// gzhan las de dang yi ge mnyam la sdeb sbyor mi 'dra ba la mdzes ldan ma zhes 'dod pa yang yod do//

//yi ge nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa kun byed la/ bha ra na lci dza su gnyis// zab mo'i dbyangs zhes rab tu grags// bha ra na'i mthar lci ba gcig dang*/ de nas dza su dza su yod na zab mo'i dbyangs zhes bya ba'i sdeb sbyor ro// //yi ge nyi shu rtsa gsum pa rnam byed la phye na/ na dza bha yang lci dza sa// dza su gnyis sdod rta rol pa// na dza bha'i mthar yang ba dang lci ba yod cing dza sa lan gnyis sbrel ba la yi ge bcu gcig pa dang*/ de nas bcu gnyis pa'i mthar ngal bso ba yod na rta rol pa zhes bya'o// myos rtsan ma gnyis lci gnyis na// yang gnyis na gsum lci gsum sdod// ma gnyis kyi mthar lci ba gnyis dang na'i mthar yang ba gnyis dang*/ de nas na gsum gyi mthar lci ba gcig yod la/ brgyad pa dang*/ lnga pa dang*/ bcu par ngal bso na myos ma rtsen pa zhes bya'o// //nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa legs byed la/ lus phra bha lci lci dang na gnyis lci ba bha gnyis na// yu rnams mda' dang dbyangs dang nyi mar sdod// bha lci lci na na lci bha bha na ya rnams la yi ge lnga pa dang*/ bdun pa dang bcu gnyis par ngal bso na lus phra zhes bya ba'i sdeb sbyor du 'gyur ro// //nyi shu rtsa lnga pa shin tu legs byed la/ bha lci lci dang bha dang lci gnyis na gnyis yang ba gnyis// na gnyis lci ba bzhi 'jog khrung khrung rkang*// bha lci lci bha lci lci na na yang yang na na lci ba'i yi ge rnams la bzhi ru 'jog pa ste/ yi ge lnga dang*/ lnga dang*/ brgyad dang bdun pa'i gnas su ngal bso na khrung khrung rkang zhes bya'o// //yi ge nyi shu rtsa drug pa lhag par legs byed la dbye na/ ma gnyis lci gnyis na gnyis yang gnyis su dang dza yig gnyis// lci ba bzhi sdod ltos 'gro rnam par bsgyings// ma ma lci lci na na yang yang su dza dza lci ba'i yi ge rnams la bzhir sdod pa ste/ nor lha dang*/ myos byed dang*/ sred byed dang*/ thub pa rnams la ngal bso ba ni ltos 'gro rnam bsgyings zhes bya'o// ma yi rjes su na yig drug sbrel sa mthar gnyis lci ba// dgu dang drug drug lngar 'jog bzlog phyogs 'bab// ma'i mthar na drug gi mthar sa gcig dang lci ba gnyis yod la// yi ge dgu pa dang*/

/de dag phyed mnyam rgyud 'phel yin// kha sgo kha sgo phan pa dang*// bzlog pa phan dang gya gyu can// yangs ma kha sgo yangs ma dang*// bha dang ra dang na ta ma// de dag de yi yangs mar 'gyur// de dag mi ldan bla re ste// de dag phal gyis sbyor ba mang*// rkang bzhi 'phel ba kun nas btser// me tog zlum po yud tsam rol// bdud rtsi'i rgyun no steng 'gro las// dri ldan rol par mkhas rnams bzhed// rab tu dal 'gro'i sdeb sbyor las// nyer gnas rab tu dal 'gro dang*// 'phel ba can dang mchog ldan te// de ni dag pa'i snang las phye// de las cung zad bsgyur ba la// mtshan mo zhes byar la la 'dod// de dag mi mnyam rgyud 'phel du// mkhas pa rnams la grags pa yin// bskyed la sdeb sbyor rnam pa gsum// 'phags pa las ni phan byed dang*// yang ma las ni gya gyu dang*// kha sgo gya gyu zhes bya dang*// lus brten gya gyu dbyangs nyid dang*// nye ba'i dbyangs dang 'phags pa'i dbyangs// ro langs can las nye sdeb sbyor// kun nas bsrabs pa sngon 'phel dang*// phyi 'phel dang ni rab tu 'phel// gzhan gyi mtha' can mdzes rgod ma'o// phyi mo mnyam las mi g.yo brtan// nyer bkra khyad par tshigs bcad dang*// nags khrod gnas dang bkra ba dang*// rkang 'khrugs dang ni lus med rtsen// shin tu gsal mdzes zhes bya rnams// phyi mo bgrang ba'i sdeb sbyor yin// zhes bya ba ni bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa dag go /'di dag sdeb sbyor mkhan rnams la// legs par grags pa'i tshigs bcad yin// rkang pa bzhi dang ldan pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni/ sdeb sbyor ba rnams la grags pa'i tshigs su bcad pa yin no// gnyis las 'phros pa drug gi bar// rkang ldan lung las grags par 'dod// rkang pa gnyis yod pa la rtsa ba gnyis kyi tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ de bzhin du rkang pa gsum pa dang*/ bzhi pa dang*/ lnga pa dang*/ drug pa zhes grags pa ni/

bcom ldan 'das kyi lung dang bstan bcos byed pa 'ga' zhig gis mdzad mod kyi/ sdeb sbyor byed pa rnams kyi 'di'i mtshan nyid mi 'dod do// de lta bu'i tshigs su bcad pa yin mod kyi/ gā tha zhes bya ba la sogs pa grags pa yin no// rkang ldan ni tshigs bcad do// des na/ sngar bshad pa yi mtshan nyid can// de 'dra'i sdeb sbyor legs rtogs nas// tshigs bcad rnams la 'jug pa yin// 'di la rgyan gzhan sbyor shes na// mkhas pa rnams kyi yid 'phrog byed// de ltar sdeb sbyor gyi mtshan nyid shes nas tshigs su bcad pa la 'jug pa yin la/ de lta bu'i tshul 'di yang legs par sbyar ba'i skad la lci yang dang ring thung dang rtags dang drag zhan la sogs pa'i bye brag sdeb sbyor ba dag gis bsdebs na/ phreng rgyud mkhan pos sna tshogs pa'i me tog gi phreng ba spel ba'am/ legs par sbyangs pa'i gser gyi rgyan rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa'am/ g.yos legs par byas pa'i kha zas ro brgya dang ldan pa bru ba tsha bas nyen pa za ba'am/ rgyud stong dang ldan pa'i pi wang dri za'i dbyangs kyis dkyus sbyar ba/ 'dod chags dang ma bral pas nyan pa ltar yid mngon par 'phrog pa yin na yang*/ bod kyi yul kla klo las cung zad brda 'byor ba/ mkhas pa dang mi mkhas pa'i rnam par dbye ba mi shes pa/ tshig dang tshig gi rgyan la blo kha ma phyogs pa/ mi mkhas shing spyi brtol la nga rgyal du 'dzin pa/ gser dang ra gan mi phyed pa/ rang nyid blun pos chog par 'dzin pa/ gos rin po che bas pags pa bsdus pa la mkho bar sems pa/ g.yos legs par sbyar ba las ltar khengs pa la dam par 'dzin pa'i mtha' 'khob 'dir/ rang nyid kyi skad la ngo bo nyid kyi sdeb sbyor gyi tha snyad med la/ legs par sbyar ba'i skad nyid las bod du bsgyur yang za 'og gi mdun gyi ri mo bsgyur ba rgyab tu mi 'byung ba ltar/ don tsam zhig bsgyur bar nus kyi/

sdeb sbyor bsgyur du mi rung zhing*/ bdag cag lta bu legs par shes pa dag gis kyang bod kyi skad la ji ltar 'bad du zin kyang*/ lwa ba'i thags la gos chen gyi ri mo mi shes pa ltar/ legs par sbyar ba'i sdeb sbyor bod kyi skad la mi 'byor bas/ sdeb sbyor mtshan nyid pa bod skad la dper brjod pa ma byas so// tshig gi rgyan sbyor ba'i tshul yang*/ kho bos mkhas pa rnams 'jug pa'i sgor bshad zin la/ 'dir skabs ma yin pas ma phye'o// gal te bod skad la sdeb sbyor mtshan nyid pa mi nyan na/ 'di ci'i phyir bshad ce na/ 'on kyang 'di na che bar rlom pa dag 'khrul bar smra ba du ma mthong*/ mtha' 'khob 'di na mi mkhas bzhin du shes par khas che ba dag sdeb sbyor gyi ming dang mtshan nyid phyin ci log tu smra bar mthong nas/ da phyin chad de skad smra bar gyur cig snyam du bsams nas/ ma 'ongs pa yi mkhas pa 'ga'// log pa'i lam las bskyab phyir byas// bdag pas blo gros dman pa bdag gi rjes su 'brangs pa 'ga' zhig ma rtogs pa dang*/ log par rtogs pa dang the tshom gyi mtha' spang ba'i phyir bstan bcos 'di sbyar gyi/ mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyis sems kyi tha ba sra ba/ the tshom gyi mdud pas mi shes pa'i blo dam du bsdams pa/ phrag dog gi mig nyam chung bas pha rol gyi shes rab kyi nyi ma'i 'od zer mi bzod pa'i skye bo rnams kyi don du bstan bcos 'di ma sbyar ro// 'o na 'di dang mi mthun pa gzhan du brda btags pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ smras pa/ la lar gzhan du bshad pa rnams// bod kyis go ba bde phyir bsgyur// mtshan yang dag par brjod pa rgya gar la yi ge brgyad pa rjes su bsngags par yod pa la/ bod la bklag bde ba'i phyir yi ge bdun par bsgyur ba dang*/ dge tshul gyi tshig le'ur byas pa sum brgya pa yi ge bcu gcig pa dbang po rdo rjer yod pa/ bod la tshig par dgu bar bsgyur ba dang*/

bshes pa'i spring yig 'phags pa'i dbyangs/ rkang pa so so yi ge mi mnyam par yod pa la yi ge mnyam por bsdebs nas tsheg par dgu par bsgyur ba dang*/ me tog phreng 'dzin yi ge nyi shu rtsa gcig pa la bcu dgu par bsgyur ba la sogs pa/ rgya gar gyi sdeb sbyor dang mi mthun par bod la go bde zhing bklag sla bar bya ba'i phyir/ yi ge phri zhing bsdebs nas don tshang zhing ma nor bar bsgyur bar zad do// kho bos 'dir bshad pa ni/ rgya gar gyi sdeb sbyor mtshan nyid pa bris pa yin pas/ mkhas pa rnams kyis 'di kho na bzhin shes par byos shig gal te khyod kyis bshad pa gzhan gyis 'dzin nam zhe na/ 'on kyang spre'u lta bu 'ga'// bstan bcos dor nas tshig 'bru len// ma 'ongs pa'i dus kyi spre'u dang 'dra ba'i dge sbyong 'ga' zhig phrag dog gi stobs kyis bstan bcos rin po che mi len par smod cing*/ 'di nas 'byung ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'i ming rnams brkus nas slob dpon gzhan las 'byung ba ltar 'chos shing*/ slob ma'i mgo bskor ba dag 'byung bar 'gyur la/ de dag gi bsam pa la yang sdeb sbyor gyi tshul 'di dag mkhas pa phal che ba la grags pa zhig go snyam pa 'byung ste/ de dag chos kyis phongs pa'i las kyi sgrib par 'gyur ro// lugs 'di gangs ri'i khrod 'di na// bdag ma yin la sngon chad med// sdeb sbyor gyi lugs 'di rgya gar gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis legs par shes mod kyi/ bod kyi yul kha ba can gyi khrod 'dir skad gnyis smra ba mang du byung yang legs par shes pa kho bo tsam yin no// ska cog dang rin chen bzang po la sogs pa 'gas/ mkhyen du zin yang rnam par gzhag pa ma mdzad do// gzhan dang gzhan dag las kyang sngon chad ma byung la/ de'i stobs kyis nor bar smra bar du ma byung ba yin no// da slan chad gal te ma nor bar smra ba 'byung ba de thams cad gzhung lugs 'di las byung bar shes par gyis shig

'o na khyod kyis ji ltar rtogs she na/ skye ba gzhan du sbyangs pa dang*// mkhas pa du ma bstan pa dang*// rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros kyis// shes bya kun la 'jigs med thob// rgyu sngon du song ba'i 'bras bu'i rtags las rjes su dpags na/ skye ba sngon rabs du mar legs par sbyar ba'i sgra dang*/ tshad ma dang*/ sdeb sbyor dang*/ snyan ngag dang*/ tshig gi rgyan dang*/ tshig rnam par sbyar ba la sogs pa la mang du sbyangs pa tshad mas grub pa dang*/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la ma rmongs pa'i bdag nyid chen po dag las tshe 'dir thos pa mang du bsags pa dang*/ skye bas thob pa'i shes rab dang*/ bla ma dam pas byin gyis brlabs pa la sogs pa rgyu du ma la brten nas/ sgra dang*/ tshad ma dang*/ sdeb sbyor dang*/ snyan ngag dang*/ tshig gi rgyan dang*/ tshig rnam par sbyar ba la sogs pa rnams tshigs chung dus bde blag tu thos shing rtogs te khong du chud nas bstan bcos 'di sbyar ba yin no// shes bya kun la 'jigs med thob// ces bya ba'i sgra yang mkhas pa rnams la nye bar mkho ba rnams shes pa la/ kun la mi 'jigs pa'i sgra 'jug ste// mi kun tshogs zhes bya ba'am// sman kun tshang zhes bya ba'i sgra bzhin no// rnam 'grel las kyang*/ 'di yis srin grangs ji snyed mkhyen// nged la nam yang nyer mkho med// ring po mthong ba'am med kyang rung*// 'dod pa'i de nyid mthong ba yin// zhes bshad pa ltar ro// //rnam pa sna tshogs sdeb sbyor gyis bkra phreng rgyud mkhan gyi phreng ba yis// me tog chun po kun nas spel legs yid 'phrog dri yi dris khyab pa// blo gros gsal ldan sbrang rtsi 'dzin pa dar dir sgra yi sgra dbyangs can// snyan ngag mkhan gyi blo yi khang bzangs legs par bkra phyir gzhung 'di spros// gangs ri'i khrod kyi blo gsal kun 'dus kyang*// rig pa'i gnas lnga kun la blos mi lcogs// mkha' la rgyu skar bye ba'i 'od 'dus kyang*// tsha zer byed pa'i phrin las 'grub par dka'// bdag kyang las kyi 'du 'phrod mi bzang pas// snyigs ma'i dus su gangs ri'i khrod 'dir skyes// 'on kyang snga ma'i bag chags goms pa yis// shes bya phal cher 'bad pa chung ngus shes// de lta mod yi sbrul gdug gnas pa'i sar// sgron me gsal yang 'od zer mi 'byung ltar// blun po lo brgyas cung zad shes rnams kyi// dbus su bdag gi blo gros la gsal// mkhas pa la la mtsho bzhin ngang gis gang*// la la 'bru mar bzhin du btsir las byung*// la la phongs pa'i nor bzhin 'bad pas bsgrubs// la la rgyal po'i bu bzhin lhun gyis grub// de ltar blo gros gsal dang mi gsal dang*// mkhas dang mi mkhas rnam dbye rjes dpag las// blo chen gzhan gyi blo yi bang mdzod la// blo chung rnams kyis the tshom ma byed cig

/blo gros sprin chen thos pa'i glog gi phreng ba can// spobs pa myur 'jug sgra dbyangs legs sgrigs sdeb sbyor tshig gi char 'bebs shing*// blo gsal char sdod 'dab skyob tshogs rnams yid 'phrog pa// 'di las legs tshogs lo tog legs bskrun de las 'jam pa'i dpal du 'gyur// gzhung 'di rnam dpyod blo gros mi chung ba// bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhes byas yang nas yang*// gsol ba btab nas kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal// bzang pos dpal ldan sa skya'i dgon par bris// 'di la dga' bas nyan dang sems rnams kyi// sems la 'jam pa'i rdo rje rjes zhugs nas// khyad par tshig gi don la mkhas pa yi// nges par byin gyis rlob par bdag gis shes// sdeb sbyor sna tshogs kyi me tog gi chun po zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos yul byang phyogs kyi rgyud/ kha ba can gyi ljongs/ grom pa dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang na bzhugs pa/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gsung gi zhabs rdul gyis/ thugs kyi dbu la reg pas/ lhun gyis grub pa'i mkhyen rab la mnga' 'byor pa/ chos kyi grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhal snga nas kyi byin gyis brlab kyi zla zer gyi stobs kyis so sor rtog pa'i kun+da'i phreng ba kha bye bas/ yongs su grags pa'i shes bya phal mo che blos yul du byas pas/ 'chad pa dang*/ rtsom pa dang*/ rtsod pa'i tshul la spobs pa dge ba can shākya'i dge slong kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bya bas/ dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du legs par sbyar ba 'di rdzogs so// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
